newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Business investment key to GDP forecast - RBA.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Business investment key to GDP forecast - RBA.

text.p: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Governor Bernie Fraser said the main key to achieving the government's forecast for 3.5 percent GDP growth 1996/97 (July/June) was business investment.

Speaking at a business seminar in Tokyo, Fraser said 1996/97 should be a year of reasonable growth with inflation comfortably within the two to three percent target and the current account deficit relatively subdued.
"The main key to achieving the 3.5 percent GDP growth forecast for 1996/97 is business investment," Fraser said.
In the 1996/97 budget, the government forecast real business investment to grow at 14 percent, after growing by 10 percent last year and 17 percent the year before.
